changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO investment_movement (investment_id, kind, amount_cents, balance_after_cents, occurred_at) SELECT ih.investment_id, CASE WHEN ih.year_month = fm.min_ym THEN 'INITIAL' ELSE 'DEPOSIT' END, CASE WHEN ih.year_month = fm.min_ym THEN ih.amount_cents ELSE ih.contributed_cents END, ih.amount_cents, (TRIM(ih.year_month) || '-01')::timestamptz FROM investment_history ih JOIN (SELECT investment_id, MIN(year_month) AS min_ym FROM investment_history GROUP BY investment_id) fm ON fm.investment_id = ih.investment_id WHERE (ih.year_month = fm.min_ym OR ih.contributed_cents > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM investment_movement m WHERE m.investment_id = ih.investment_id);
